changes: Follow a YouTube channel in Studio to show its latest public uploads in a category.
YouTube cover thumbnails are saved automatically as you add titles or browse, so library titles keep their artwork offline.
Use a phone or computer to approve Google sign-in on older Android TVs when device sign-in is configured.
Fixed the Google sign-in popup in web browsers.
Sign in with Google to sync a private library of videos and categories across devices.
Save compatible direct videos for offline playback with a configurable device storage limit.

Videos play one after another through the list you picked, with an Up next countdown.

Discover and Library pages with categories and remote-friendly navigation.
